title: GMKtec M3S Mini PC Intel Core 3 304 (Up to 4.3GHz) LPDDR5 12GB RAM 512GB SSD
writeup: The GMKtec M3S is a 430-gram mini PC for a one to three monitor office desk, with two HDMI 2.0 ports and USB4 that GMKtec says can drive three 4K displays at 60Hz, plus 2.5GbE, Wi-Fi 6 and two spare M.2 slots. Its Core 3 304 has five threads and the 12GB of LPDDR5 is soldered, so it suits browsing, documents and video calls rather than gaming, video exports or virtual machines. Specs come from GMKtec's product page and the minis-pc.com review. We have not tested it.
